[h2]■ v0.1.0 distribution[/h2]

[h3]A trial version is now available at the following link! [/h3]
https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/25820/article/1214444


The basics of the combat system have been completed.
The quality is not high at this point, but you can get an early taste of the atmosphere of this work.
If you are interested, please play it!


[h2]■ Timing of distributing the demo version on Steam[/h2]

We will distribute the demo version after development has progressed and a certain level of quality has been reached.
Specifically, we plan to distribute it from the end of 2024 to the beginning of 2025.
